subject: Quick ask: 1-line quote + metric for BrightWave case
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick ask: 1-line quote + metric for BrightWave case

Hi Elena —

Hope you had a smooth week. We were updating our customer-facing one-pager for BrightWave and wanted to include a concise quote and one measurable outcome if possible. Would you be comfortable sharing: 1) a one-sentence customer quote we can attribute to you (short, ~20 words), and 2) one headline metric we can call out (e.g., "reduced inference latency by 45%" or "cut per-request cost by 38%")?

We drafted a quick template (attached) — feel free to edit verbatim. If you prefer, we can anonymize numbers and/or run this by your legal/brand team first. Goal: have a slide-ready line + metric by EOD Tue (June 15) for the sales deck update.

Attachments: one-pager_template_v1.pdf

Thanks again for being so collaborative on this — it’s been great working with BrightWave.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Cruz <elena@brightwave.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-10T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 1-line quote + metric for BrightWave case

Hi Karthik —

Happy to help. Below are two quick options — use whichever fits the tone:

1) "Redwood’s runtime cut our average request latency by ~42% while keeping responses consistent — immediate product impact."
2) "We saw a 37% reduction in per-token cost after switching to Redwood’s batching and KV cache configuration."

Headline metric (measured on our p95 synthetic workload): 42% latency reduction, 37% cost reduction (baseline: our prior managed endpoint).

You have permission to use BrightWave logo and the lines above. If you need a signed permission, we can do that — otherwise consider this an OK from my side.

Cheers,
Elena Cruz
Director of ML
BrightWave Inc.

Marissa / Monica — forwarding Elena's reply (below). She gave two candidate lines and explicit permission to use the logo.

Action items I’d like help with:
- Marissa: can you pick the tighter 1-liner for slide copy and slot it into the existing one-pager? We want something punchy for the sales deck hero slide.
- Monica: can you check whether the 42%/37% numbers need anonymization for compliance, or if we can use them as-is (we should confirm SOC2-related guidance).

I attached the raw quote and a quick metrics export from their POC. If we need a signed permission, I can loop Elena in on a DocuSign.

Attachments: customer_quote_raw.txt, metrics_export.csv

Thanks — want to get the deck update in time for Monday’s enterprise call.

—Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-10T14:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: 1-line quote + metric for BrightWave case

Thanks for the ping. Nice to have an explicit permission. A couple notes: 

- Marketing will prefer the first line Elena suggested (latency-focused) for the hero slide; it reads stronger for product buyers.
- For the numbers: SOC2/brand teams usually require a short footnote if we quote a specific percentile and the baseline. Can we add: "measured on BrightWave p95 synthetic workload; baseline = prior managed endpoint" as a parenthetical? That will keep us honest.
- Legal: if we reproduce Elena's exact wording we should confirm email permission is acceptable. For larger case study collateral (one-pager PDF) Legal typically asks for a signed permission. DocuSign is fine — I can route a brief approval template.

Suggested one-liner for slide (edited for brevity): "Redwood cut our request latency by ~42% while keeping outputs consistent."

If Marissa is good with that, I’ll spin up the DocuSign and flag the SOC2 footnote.

—Monica
Senior Manager, Marketing Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-11T13:45:00Z
Subject: Quick confirmation + permission request (one-line + logo)

Elena — thanks again for the quick options, they’re perfect. Two quick asks to finalize: 1) Please confirm the exact short line we can use (we suggest: "Redwood cut our request latency by ~42% while keeping outputs consistent.") and 2) please confirm you’re OK with us using the BrightWave logo on the one-pager and slide. 

If email is fine, your one-line confirmation plus an "OK to use logo" reply here is sufficient for our internal process. If not, we’ll send a short DocuSign (link: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/ABC123).

If it helps, Monica will add the parenthetical note on measurement on the slide: "(measured on BrightWave p95 synthetic workload; baseline = prior managed endpoint)".

Appreciate it — aiming to lock the deck by EOD Monday.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
